column1: # The banned spellings of scripts/shtest-clock-check.sh, closed world: one row each, `{spelling}<TAB>{extended regex}`.
# A line of a scanned file holding the regex is a site named by the spelling. <B> stands for the left edge of a
# command word (line start, a character no name part can be, or a printf `\n`/`\t` escape), <E> for its right edge. The spellings are this
# file's subject, so they live here, in no shell file, and the check never scans this table.
